digest.component_or_area: tests/interfaces conftest — rebar_repo session template and copy-per-test
propositions: tests/interfaces tier fixture setup is 47% of wall-clock (306 ms per function-scoped rebar_repo call, 589 tests requesting it, 58 git spawns) due to mkdir, git init, git config, rebar.init_repo, and git commit per test
Building an initialized repo once per xdist worker via tmp_path_factory and copying via shutil.copytree(symlinks=True) reduces setup time from 306 ms to 22.3 ms per test (13.7x gain)

A copy requires four fix-ups: rewrite worktree pointers (.tickets-tracker/.git and .git/worktrees/-tickets-tracker/gitdir) against copy's realpath; set REBAR_GATE_TMPDIR per test to prevent snapshot store key collisions; unconditionally re-randomize .env-id and .signing-key to maintain environment identity isolation; reset src/rebar/_store/ensures._pending_cache after each copy

Bare git worktree repair is a silent no-op (validates by path existence, leaves copy on template's object store, causes writes to advance template's refs) and must be rejected; git worktree list --porcelain guard detects stale gitdir pointers while git rev-parse --git-common-dir cannot

The template fixture must build inside pytest.MonkeyPatch.context() that isolates REBAR_ROOT, XDG_CONFIG_HOME, and clears REBAR_TRACKER_DIR/REBAR_TRACKER_BRANCH/REBAR_CONFIG environment variables to prevent autouse or first-requester contamination

Deliberate build-from-scratch coverage is retained by tests/interfaces/store/test_init_idempotent_scratch.py and tests/interfaces/store/test_e4_init.py; tests/interfaces/test_rebar_repo_isolation.py sentinel tests prove half-fixed copies, bare-repair copies, and template path leakage are rejected
